title: Tara NDE 140
content:
When I was 7 years old, I went to a beach with a friend. We decided to climb a cliff. We were up about 20 meters when I became stuck. My friend went around the cliff face to tell her mother. My hands began to slip and my legs shook uncontrollably. My fingers slipped off the rocks and I began to fall backwards. As I was falling, I opened my eyes to see that I was upside down and that I seemed to be looking out of a tunnel. I couldn't hear or feel anything. I had opened my eyes 2 times on the way down and I was still upside down. I still couldn't hear or feel anything. I was conscious to the fact that I was bouncing and hitting the cliff. I remember thinking it was taking a long time to get to the bottom. Everything was in slow motion, but at no point was I scared. I wasn't aware of landing, but I opened my eyes to find I was laying on the ground with my head tilted back. I still couldn't feel or hear, but I saw a lady standing a couple of meters away from me. This lady was white. She had a long white see-through dress with long white hair. She seemed to glow. I was wondering why she wasn't helping me. She just stood there and smiled at me. I thought I must have been dead. That's why she wouldn't help me. When I decided to ask her for help, she seemed to read my mind. I was asking, but I wasn't saying it out loud; I just seemed to think it. I asked her to help me, but she just stood there. I kept asking. The more I asked, the more she wouldn't help, the more I became distressed. I had asked her approximately 3 or 4 times. On the last time I asked, she replied, ‘You're all right,’ and smiled. I said, ‘No, I'm not,’ as she smiled and went away. I closed my eyes, then my senses started coming back. I could now feel and hear. I started screaming, when my friend’s mother came. I asked if I was dead. The obvious answer was ‘No’. I told her the lady wouldn't help me. She asked ‘What lady?’ I said the white lady, but there was nobody around. As I was lifted to my feet, the only injuries I had were grazes to my legs. When we looked up the cliff face, I should have been dead or seriously injured.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "lady" standing a couple of meters away, described as "white," with "a long white see-through dress" and "long white hair" who "seemed to glow" and smiled.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell backwards off a cliff while climbing at a beach (about 20 meters up), bouncing/hitting the cliff on the way down.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Slow-motion fall with inability to hear/feel; visual of a glowing "white lady" who communicated mentally and said, "You're all right."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel-like perception occurred during the fall; encounter with a being occurred after finding herself on the ground; then senses returned.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel perception described as "looking out of a tunnel" while physically falling upside down; no report of leaving the body or entering another realm.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You're all right.” / “No, I'm not.” / “I thought I must have been dead.”
